storage: one append-only JSONL file per graph-parameter-method task
durability: each event is appended and fsynced before emit returns
counter_semantics: Cumulative before/after snapshots; unavailable values and invalid deltas are JSON null, never zero.
clause_category_note: The current encoder does not expose safe category counts; no formula instrumentation was added.
learned_clause_note: The selected PySAT backend does not provide a supported learned-clause count through the current API.
recovery: On resume, an incomplete final JSONL fragment is archived and only its complete newline-terminated prefix is retained. Unmatched starts are marked INTERRUPTED only after the prior worker is known to have stopped.
